clue.text: Far away, not appearing to have been troubled

parts.note: someone who does not appear is absent
to be minded is to have been bothered, as in 'I'm not minded about it'

explanation.surface: Someone distant and pale, not looking as though anything has upset them.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamy, distracted person is said to be far away, lost in thought.

clue.text: Silver on first appearance for old competitor

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
1st, with the figure read as the letter I, gives IST

explanation.surface: A runner-up winning silver at their debut, now a veteran athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appearance for' is padding that links the pieces to the definition; 'first' is written 1ST with I for the figure one.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece a contestant at the public games was called by this name, from agon, a contest.

clue.text: Plant needing Southern border

parts.note: an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A garden plant that needs to go along the southern border.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grass-like marsh plant.

clue.text: Biscuit designed, they say, to follow state diet

parts.note: a ginger nut is a kind of biscuit
RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state

indicators.note: signals that the word is replaced by one that sounds the same when spoken

parts.note: something designed is meant, as in 'it was meant to happen'

explanation.surface: A biscuit said to be made for anyone following a state-approved diet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to follow' places the sound-alike after RI.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutriment is nourishing food, what one eats as sustenance.

clue.text: Holy men reconstructing image out east

indicators.note: reconstructing means the remaining letters are rebuilt in a new order
out means the letter for east is dropped from the word image

explanation.surface: Clerics restoring a religious icon that has been shipped out to the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' takes E from IMAGE to leave IMAG, and 'reconstructing' rearranges those four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The wise men from the East who visited the infant Jesus are traditionally holy figures.

clue.text: His relations may tell tales

parts.note: relations here are accounts or recountings, not relatives: the person who gives them is a storyteller

explanation.surface: A man whose family members are gossips who might snitch.
explanation.definitionFit: A storyteller relates events, and his relations are the stories he recounts.

clue.text: Old money in notes smoothed the way

indicators.note: in means the old coin goes inside the string of musical notes

parts.note: E, E and D are three musical notes
the as was an ancient Roman coin

explanation.surface: Ancient currency used to grease palms, making things go smoothly.
explanation.definitionFit: To have eased something is to have made it easier, removing obstacles.

clue.text: Brave revolutionary tracking territorial detachment under -commandant.

indicators.note: in a down answer one piece written under another follows it
tracking means following behind, so this piece comes last

parts.note: CO, commanding officer, stands for a commandant
the Isle of Man is a self-governing territory detached from Britain
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: A bold rebel shadowing a unit of the Territorial Army that serves under a commandant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brave' as a noun is a Native American warrior; the Isle of Man is a Crown dependency off the British coast.
explanation.definitionFit: A Native American warrior is traditionally called a brave, and the Comanche were a Plains people.

clue.text: Ask for a little money on ring

parts.note: p, a penny, is a small unit of British money
a peal is a ring of bells

explanation.surface: Request a small sum when making a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To appeal is to make an earnest request.

clue.text: Speculator taken in by senior experienced person

indicators.note: taken in by means the speculator is enclosed by the word for senior

parts.note: senior means older
a stag is a speculator who buys new shares to sell quickly at a profit

explanation.surface: A gullible investor fooled by an older, wiser hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran who has been around a long time is an experienced old hand.

clue.text: Retreating waters reveal -vessel

indicators.note: retreating means moving backwards, so the word for waters is read the other way

parts.note: pools are bodies of water

explanation.surface: As the tide goes out, a boat is left exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloop is a single-masted sailing boat.

clue.text: Pacific empire Nicholas absorbed

indicators.note: absorbed means the letters are held within the words empire Nicholas

explanation.surface: A Russian tsar named Nicholas swallowed up a Pacific empire.
explanation.definitionFit: Irenic means peaceful, promoting peace, which is what pacific means.

clue.text: Kind of construction manual prepared

parts.note: manual work is done by hand
prepared means made

explanation.surface: A DIY guide to building, ready to use.
explanation.definitionFit: Things crafted without machines are described this way, a type of making.

clue.text: Whittington as painter?

definitions.meaning: Dick Whittington, in the legend, heard Bow Bells and turned again, so he was one who turned back

explanation.definitionFit: Whittington turned back to London on hearing the bells; Turner the artist painted seascapes.

clue.text: Revised plans for radical water transport

parts.note: red is used for a political radical
rafts carry people and goods on water

explanation.surface: Fresh proposals for a revolutionary river transport scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: To redraft is to write a new version, so redrafts are revisions of plans.

clue.text: Kind of licence needed for ace pilot's aerobatics

indicators.note: aerobatics are twists and loops, so the letters of ace pilot are tumbled into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: An air ace needs a special permit before performing stunts.
explanation.definitionFit: Poetic licence is the freedom a writer takes with facts or grammar.

clue.text: Advocates getting in money to build large food store

indicators.note: getting in means the advocates are placed inside the word for money

parts.note: tin is slang for money
the Bar is the collective body of barristers

explanation.surface: Lawyers raise funds to put up a big warehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting in' means the advocates go inside the money. A tithe barn was a medieval barn holding the tenth of farm produce owed to the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a barn stored grain and other produce paid as church dues, a big storehouse for food.

clue.text: Ararat perhaps for man out in storm

indicators.note: a storm throws things about, so the letters of man out in are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Noah's peak, maybe, for someone caught outdoors in bad weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' marks Ararat as one example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ararat is a peak in Turkey where Noah's ark is said to have come to rest.

clue.text: Easing of tension is' noted -a new development

indicators.note: a new development reshapes things, so the letters of is noted a are rearranged

explanation.surface: A report notes that a fresh turn of events has calmed nerves.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedation is calming by drugs, relieving anxiety and nervous stress.

clue.text: Bear -.with a sore head possibly?

definitions.meaning: to bear something is to endure it
someone with a headache is in pain, enduring it

explanation.definitionFit: To bear pain is to endure it, and a person nursing a headache is enduring discomfort.

clue.text: A race tip? Get along with you!

parts.note: the TT, Tourist Trophy, is a motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
a tip is an end

explanation.surface: A racing tipster is told brusquely to go away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get along with you' sounds like a dismissal, but it means accompany.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend someone is to go along with them as a companion or escort.

clue.text: Police search operation is granted broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of granted are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Permission is given to publicise a police manhunt.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragnet is a systematic sweep by police to catch suspects.

clue.text: Breaking foot, totters a bit

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so the abbreviation for foot is broken apart by the word for totters

parts.note: totters are rag-and-bone men, collectors of old clothes and scrap

explanation.surface: Someone who has broken a foot is a little unsteady on their feet.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a totter is a rag-and-bone man, a street scrap collector; RAGMEN splits F...T.
explanation.definitionFit: A fragment is a small piece broken off something.

clue.text: A second's start would give obvious pleasure to this runner

definitions.text: A second's start would give obvious pleasure to this runner

parts.words: A second's start would give obvious pleasure to this runner
parts.note: putting S, the abbreviation for second, at the start of this athlete's name makes someone who visibly beams

explanation.surface: A sprinter would be delighted with a head start of one second.
explanation.walkthrough: With S in front the runner becomes a SMILER, a person showing obvious pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: This athlete specialises in a race over one mile.

clue.text: , Appointment with a girl

parts.note: a berth is a post or job, as in 'a cushy berth'

explanation.surface: A date with a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertha is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Triumph obvious in Lawrence yarn'

indicators.note: obvious in means seen inside, so the word for triumph shows within the initials

parts.note: T E Lawrence was Lawrence of Arabia
a triumph is a win

explanation.surface: Lawrence of Arabia's victory shows clearly in his tale.
explanation.definitionFit: Twine is strong thread, a type of spun yarn.

clue.text: Books in charge of auditors

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a collection of books

explanation.surface: Financial records overseen by the accountants who check them.
explanation.definitionFit: Otic means relating to the ear, and auditors are listeners.

clue.text: Former student about to crack up.

indicators.note: about means the pieces for former and student go around the word to

parts.note: ex means former
L, a learner, stands for a student

explanation.surface: An old pupil on the verge of a breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack something up is to praise it highly, as in 'not all it's cracked up to be'.

clue.text: What drives Greek character back into battle

indicators.note: into means the reversed letter goes inside the word for battle

parts.note: action is fighting, battle

indicators.note: back means the Greek letter's name is read from right to left

parts.note: tau is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Something that spurs a Greek hero to return to the fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns TAU into UAT, which goes into ACTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Actuation is the act of setting something in motion, the force that powers it.

clue.text: Rise about noon in river is beyond human experience

indicators.note: in means the rising piece sits inside the name of the river

parts.note: the Trent is a major English river

indicators.note: about means the word for rise goes around the letter for noon

parts.note: to ascend is to rise

explanation.surface: Climbing at midday in a river is a sublime, otherworldly experience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the rise around noon, giving ANSCEND, and 'in' sets that inside the river, an English one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something transcendent goes beyond ordinary limits, surpassing the physical world.
